positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Coconut Creek, Florida, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Proficient in Next.js for building scalable and efficient web applications.
• Extensive experience in developing SAAS platforms, from concept to deployment.
• Skilled in implementing authentication systems to ensure data security and user privacy.
• Familiarity with modern data fetching techniques using tRPC & Zod for optimized performance.
• Knowledgeable in leveraging OpenAI for advanced AI capabilities within software applications.
• Experienced in designing modern user interfaces using 'shadcn-ui', React, Prism, and Tailwind CSS.
• Familiar with LangChain for Infinite AI Memory and Pinecone as vector storage solutions.
• Proficient in integrating payment processing functionality using Stripe for e-commerce applications.
• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked on BetterNOI website
• Developed and maintained web applications using Django framework, ensuring high performance and 
   scalability.
• Implemented automated testing using pytest and Selenium, resulting in a significant reduction in 
   manual testing time.
• Conducted web scraping tasks to gather data for analysis and integration into existing systems.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design and implement RESTful APIs for seamless 
   integration between different modules.
• Managed databases using MariaDB, optimizing queries for improved performance and reliability.
• Utilized Hadoop ecosystem for processing and analyzing large datasets, implementing MapReduce 
   jobs for data transformation and aggregation.
• Contributed to the development of front-end components using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, 
   ensuring a responsive and user-friendly interface.

positions.title: React Developer - Full Stack
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained cross-platform mobile applications using React Native, ensuring 
   compatibility with both iOS and Android platforms.
• Implemented server-side rendering and optimized client-side performance using Next.js.
• Integrated Firebase backend services for real-time data synchronization, authentication, and cloud 
   functions.
• Utilized Expo CLI for rapid prototyping and deployment of mobile applications.
• Implemented OAuth2 authentication for secure user authentication and authorization.
• Managed application state and asynchronous data flow using Redux.
• Collaborated with designers to implement intuitive UI/UX designs, ensuring a seamless user 
   experience.
• Integrated NextAuth for authentication using various providers such as Google, Facebook, and 
   GitHub.
• Implemented email notification functionalities using SendGrid API.
• Conducted code reviews, provided technical guidance, and collaborated with cross-functional teams 
   to deliver high-quality software solutions on time.
positions.insights: Adobe Creative Suite and Adobe Photoshop
